messages:
Amy Chen: Heads-up — Raj looped me on a customer ask that landed via SE last night. FinEdge wants detailed per-tenant billing rows + traceability into request traces.
Jordan Patel: customer context: high-volume fintech, want to reconcile cost to request_id for audits and chargebacks. needs exportable rows for their data warehouse.
Raj Kapoor: they flagged two urgent asks: 1) per-call token & time breakdown per tenant, 2) ability to link any billing row to the original trace in our observability UI.
Emma Li: support log: customer saw a 3x spike in tokens last week and can't map which routes caused it. they asked for CSV or S3 export with one row per request.
Miguel Ortega: quick Q — do they need full call payloads? that has PII implications.
Raj Kapoor: they only asked for identifiers + model, tokens_in/out, route, duration, tenant_id, trace_id. no raw prompt text.
Sasha Ivanova: analytics note: we can produce a per-request telemetry event with schema: event_type, ts, tenant_id, route, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, trace_id, cost_estimate.
Amy Chen: high-level ask -> add a console view + export and a trace-link button from billing row -> observability trace. Proposal: "Billing -> Request Drill" in Console.
Lee Thompson: bizops: this ties to chargeback product. recommend marking as P1 for Enterprise onboarding for FinEdge trial.
Miguel Ortega: implementation constraints: emitting per-request events at high qps increases write volume. we could sample or emit full for requests > threshold.
Jordan Patel: customer requirement is for all requests above $0.10 per call and all admin-export for compliance windows. sampling won't cut it for them.
Amy Chen: tradeoffs: 1) full gather (heavy), 2) partial + query link to traces (medium), 3) on-demand exports via support (manual). Need to pick scope for MVP.
Sasha Ivanova: MVP suggestion: store lightweight invoice rows (no prompt) for every request; include trace_id which is indexed. export endpoint that streams CSV for time windows. backend storage: parquet in S3 partitioned by date + tenant.
Miguel Ortega: tech tasks: create telemetry schema, hook runtime to emit token/latency counters, add indexing for trace_id, build export job + console front-end. estimate: 3 wks backend, 2 wks frontend + QA.
Amy Chen: acceptance criteria draft:
- Every request produces a billing-row with tenant_id, route, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, trace_id, timestamp
- Console: per-tenant UI that lists rows + filter by model/route/date and a "View trace" button that opens observability with trace_id pre-filled
- Export: CSV/Parquet download for selected window and tenant (streamed)
- Privacy: no prompt text stored; PII review complete
- Performance: 99th pct latency impact < 5ms on request path
Jordan Patel: can we add a toggle per-tenant to enable/disable detailed rows? customer needs on by default for FinEdge.
Amy Chen: yes, add tenant flag (admin toggle) — default on for Enterprise customers in trial.
Lee Thompson: pricing implication — enable per-row retention tiers. Need to sync with revenue on expected storage delta.
Sasha Ivanova: alerting add-on: cost-anomaly flag by tenant that can trigger webhooks. recommend as separate follow-up.
Raj Kapoor: next steps: 1) PM to prioritize in roadmap; 2) SE to confirm FinEdge minimum window and retention needs; 3) Eng to scoping + rough estimate; 4) Legal to sign off on telemetry schema.
Amy Chen: I'll slot this into the "Enterprise observability" initiative. Asking eng for a firm estimate by EOD Friday. @Miguel Ortega please.
Miguel Ortega: I'll run a quick spike today to measure emitter overhead, and post results here.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-spike-branch to staging at 2023-11-14T05:30:00Z :rocket:
Jordan Patel: customer follow-up — I'll confirm retention (they asked 90 days) and whether they want S3 access or only downloads.
Amy Chen: thanks all — I'll capture this as an intake ticket and attach the acceptance checklist. :white_check_mark:
Emma Li: tagging support runbook: if customer reports mismatch, ask for sample time range + any trace_ids to expedite.
Sasha Ivanova: note for product: include cost-estimate field (derived from tokens*model_rate) in the row so customers can do quick reconciliation.
Amy Chen: closing note: retrospective question — do we want to generalize this for all tenants or keep enterprise-only for first iteration? thoughts? :thinking_face:
